log.text: M15 barrier: the swing low 4525.38 (a buy barrier once swept).

Price swept the swing: a wick below 4525.38 to 4520.02, and the M15 candle closed back at or above it. The sweep barrier runs 4520.02 to 4525.38. Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is with the H1 direction (buy).
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) buy, a candle closed above 4542.19. A buy limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: buy 4542.19, stop 4519.72 ($0.30 past the extreme 4520.02 made at the barrier, risk $22.47), target 4609.59 (3R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
